channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-flame
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Android — via awesome-flame
item.description: Steer two wingsuit flyers at once, one per thumb, through an endless procedural canyon that narrows as you speed up. By Teoktonos

item.title: Android — via awesome-flame
item.description: Peel a hundred fruits, each in one clean strip: trace the line, and a tension meter tears the peel if you yank. By Illumination Development

item.title: Android — via awesome-flame
item.description: A carnival shooting gallery: fifty stalls down a world's fair midway, where you splat the ducks and spare the prizes, with a daily stall. By Illumination Development

item.title: Android — via awesome-flame
item.description: Sail a wooden ship up a sea of big-eyed creatures while the cannons fire on their own, and sink a sea monster boss at the end of every voyage. By Illumination Development

item.title: iOS — via awesome-flame
item.description: A pixel-art turn-based tactics game where enemies react before your attacks land. Command mushroom warriors, outsmart enemy defenses, and reclaim a kingdom consumed by the Purple Plague. By Oleksandr Nikolaiev.

item.title: Android — via awesome-flame
item.description: Run, jump and explore four worlds with Pimbli, a little hero on a big journey. By xeinebiu

item.title: Android — via awesome-flame
item.description: , iOS - A family catching game: steer a basket to catch falling tacos and dodge the bombs, across 50 levels in five worlds, with a daily challenge and an endless mode. By Illumination Development

item.title: iOS — via awesome-flame
item.description: Meet Wormo the gooey worm in this wonderful casual game! Think you can put wormo in the nest? Think again, it requires an extraordinary technique. By Tommy Buonomo (Frenchie Games)

item.title: iOS — via awesome-flame
item.description: Can You Stand The Rain? By Kevin Omyonga

item.title: iOS — via awesome-flame
item.description: Play a fast paced arcade game by dodging various hazards and try to be top player on the world! - By Davi Bispo

item.description: Bounce from a sunny meadow into space and beyond. How high can you go? By xeinebiu
